title: Correct speed at C
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate v = 10√2 m/s (or approximately 14.14 m/s) for the speed at point C after the flat section.

title: Correct total time
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the total sliding time on the right slope as t = (1 + √5) s.

title: Energy or kinematics on flat
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the work-energy theorem or kinematics with friction to find the speed at C from the speed at B and the flat section parameters.

title: Two-phase slope analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that motion on the right slope involves an upward decelerating phase followed by a downward accelerating phase.

title: Forces on the slope
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly resolve forces and apply Newton's second law to find the accelerations for both phases on the inclined plane.

title: Kinematic linking
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly link the two phases on the slope using the common displacement x_AB or the condition that velocity is zero at the turnaround point.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's final answers should include correct units (m/s and s) and intermediate calculations should maintain dimensional consistency.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student uses the wrong sign for the acceleration during either the upward or downward phase on the slope.

title: Friction direction mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student misidentifies the direction of the friction force during either phase of motion on the inclined plane.

title: Omits flat section energy loss
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student attempts to solve part (1) without accounting for energy loss due to friction on the 10m flat section.
